title: Functional Requirements (FR) Catalog
description: Project-specific catalog of functional requirements with traceability links to code, tests, scanner rules, and compliance framework rows. Consumed by asvs-scanner via the --fr-catalog flag.

project.description: Project name. Free-form, used in dashboard headers.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this catalog was generated/last updated.

default_granularity.description: Optional. Declares the project's typical FR granularity (e.g. 'module', 'feature-folder', 'component', 'function'). Documentation hint for reviewers; not enforced.

scope.description: Project's target scope per framework. Drives which compliance rows are visible per framework tab.

additionalProperties.description: Framework-specific scope dimensions. Keys vary by framework (levels, baselines, saq, tier).

na_rows.description: Explicit out-of-scope declarations for compliance rows that have no related FR.

id.description: Project-unique stable identifier. Recommended patterns: 'FR-001', 'FR-AUTH', 'FR-AUTH-OAUTH-VERIFY'. Hierarchical IDs (matching `parent`) improve readability.

parent.description: Optional. ID of the parent FR for hierarchical catalogs. Must reference another requirement's `id` in the same catalog.

category.description: Free-form grouping label for the UI ('authentication', 'data-export', etc.). Use consistent spelling across the catalog.

description.description: Full prose. What the requirement does, key constraints, edge cases.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Drives UI filtering. Active = currently in scope.

owner.description: Optional. Team or person responsible. Free-form.

implemented_by.description: Code references. Many-to-many — a file can be claimed by multiple FRs.

verified_by.description: Test references that verify this FR. Each is resolved at scan time.

satisfies.description: Compliance framework rows this FR satisfies.

evidence.description: Evidence artifacts supporting this FR. Promoted to typed entries (auto vs manual).

path.description: Glob pattern, file path, or 'file:symbol' reference.

label.description: Optional human-friendly name for UI display.

path.description: Glob patterns must not contain ':' — that's the symbol separator.
File paths must not contain glob characters ('*', '?', '[', ']') or the symbol separator ':'.
Symbol references must be 'file:symbol' with exactly one ':' separator.

ref.description: Test reference. For unit/integration/e2e: 'path/test_xxx.py' or 'path/test_xxx.py::test_name'. For scanner: '<scanner-name>:<rule_id_or_glob>' e.g. 'semgrep:python.security.injection.sql.*'.
Scanner refs must be '<scanner-name>:<rule_id_or_glob>'. Scanner name is lowercase letters/digits/hyphens; exactly one ':' separator.
Test refs must be a file path (with optional '::test_name' or '::Class::method' suffix). Must not match the scanner ref pattern (lowercase-name:single-colon).

framework.description: Framework identifier. Uppercase letters/digits/hyphens/underscores. Examples: 'ASVS', 'NIST-800-53', 'PCI-DSS', 'ISO-27001'. Loader warns on unknown frameworks.

status.description: Defaults to 'satisfied'. 'na' marks this row as not applicable for this FR with a reason.

reason.description: Required when status is 'na'. Explains why this row is not applicable.

ref.description: Reference. For scanner/test: same format as verified_by. For manual/screenshot: file path.

status.description: 'auto' = traffic light driven by scanner/test result. 'manual' = always green if the referenced artifact exists.
